description: Interest rate instrument (term loan) deal screen, Structure tab. Reached from ftr-create-entry with product type 10B.

reach.note: No t-code opens this screen directly. Fill the entry screen from the named dataset row and press Enter. Read-only — the model check never saves.

amount.title: Amount as Text Field
amount.note: SAP returns '100,000.00'. Compared numerically, never by string equality.

contractDate.title: Contract Date
contractDate.note: Must be <= Term Start or SAP refuses the save outright ('Contract date is after start of term'). Defaults to today.

transactionNumber.title: Financial Transaction Number
transactionNumber.note: Holds the placeholder \INTERN\ until the number is assigned. Never capture that as a deal number.

frequencyIndicator.title: Frequency Indicator
frequencyIndicator.note: SRHYTHM. Default is 'At End of Term'. A periodic choice reveals frequencyCount and frequencyUnit.

frequencyCount.title: Defined Frequency in Days or Months
frequencyCount.note: Revealed only once a periodic frequency is chosen. Its absence means SAP fell back to a one-off schedule, whatever the dropdown shows.

save.note: Resolved by its exact (Ctrl+S) tooltip, not by id - the id moves between transactions.

structureTab.note: The deal screen's own tab strip, not a t-code navigation. SAP refuses to switch tabs while a required field on the current one is empty (e.g. Term Start) - fill the Structure tab first.

administrTab.note: Holds General Valuation Class, Portfolio, Guarantor, Characteristics. Same tab-switch caveat as structureTab.

generalValuationClass.title: General Valuation Class
generalValuationClass.note: Administr. tab, not Structure. Unset is fine for product types that don't require it (10B/9800 never sets this) but a hard save-time refusal for others (22A/1000: 'Fill the following required field: General Valuation Class'). Discovered via aria-controls VTGFHA-RCOMVALCLSAPLFTR_SUBSCR, not dumpScreen - see discover-ftr-gvc-field-type.spec.ts.
options: Valuation area 2: Transfer posting mid-term -> short-term
Valuation area 2 : Transfer posting long-term -> mid-term

interestCategory.title: Interest Category
interestCategory.note: Rebuilds the whole interest block - nominalRate disappears and referenceInterestRate/interestMarkup/firstPeriodRate appear once this is 'Variable'. Set before touching any field in that block (TC-003's variant-matrix rule: rate fields last). TC-003's V10 discovery (9800/10B) found SAP refuses the save without a reference rate; TC-013 (1000/22A) confirmed the same requirement and supplies one.

referenceInterestRate.title: Reference Interest Rate
referenceInterestRate.note: Present only once interestCategory = Variable. A code typed directly (e.g. RBI_REPO) - not chosen from a working F4 grid click, matching the pattern in probe-security-class.spec.ts. Valid codes are landscape- and company-code-specific; see discover-ftr-1000-22a-variable-rate.spec.ts for the full 16-option list read from DS4's own F4 search help for 1000/22A. verify:true because a dropped leading keystroke here does not produce an obviously-invalid string - it can silently select a different, real reference-rate code, the same class of risk termStart/termEnd/contractDate carry.

interestMarkup.title: Interest Markup/Markdown
interestMarkup.note: Present only once interestCategory = Variable. Left blank was accepted by the screen in discovery (no mandatory-field indicator) - untested whether SAP defaults it to zero or refuses the save without it.

firstPeriodRate.title: Interest Rate for the First Period
firstPeriodRate.note: Present only once interestCategory = Variable. Same caveat as interestMarkup - left blank in discovery, save-time behaviour unconfirmed.

interestCalcMethod.title: Interest Calculation Method
interestCalcMethod.note: Discovery (1000/22A, Variable + RBI_REPO) showed a warning 'No interest calculation method entered for reference interest rate' even though this field already displayed 'act/365' - untested whether that warning blocks the save or is informational only, like TC-002's own non-blocking check-run warnings. Not set by fillTermLoan; left for the live save's check run to reveal, per this project's discover-don't-guess rule.
